types.name: Config
docs: Layout v2. v1 accounts (77 bytes, up to `bump`) are migrated by
`set_config`, which reallocates them; until then only `set_config` can
read them. New fields must be carved out of `_reserved`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: System-owned wallet that receives fees (and owns the fee ATAs).

fields.name: fee_bps_public
docs: Release fee for the plain Solana rail.

fields.name: fee_bps_private
docs: Release fee for private rails (Cloak, Zcash).

fields.name: skr_mint
docs: Payouts in this mint pay `fee_bps_skr` on any rail, and
`skr_burn_bps` of that fee is burned. Default = no SKR discount.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin until it accepts; default = none.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Zeroed space for future fields.

types.name: FeeBurned
docs: The burned share of an SKR payout fee.

types.name: PlanKind
docs: Inheritance plans release tiers after owner silence; vesting plans
release linearly over time from a fixed start, whatever the owner does.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: Admin registry entry: the Pyth feed that prices `mint` (SOL under the
wrapped SOL mint) and the one price account payouts may read it from.

fields.name: price_account
docs: The canonical push-oracle account of `feed_id`, kept fresh by Pyth or
by our pusher. Executors cannot substitute another update.

fields.name: max_age_secs
docs: Older prices are unusable; 0 disables the feed.

types.name: Rail
docs: Delivery rail. On-chain every rail pays a Solana key; for private rails
that key is a fresh claim key whose app routes the funds onward.

fields.name: executed_at
docs: 0 while pending.

fields.name: paid
docs: Net amount the beneficiary received.

fields.name: skipped_at
docs: When later tiers were allowed to run past this one because it could
not pay within the grace period; 0 if never skipped. A skipped tier
stays claimable by its own beneficiary.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Share set aside for a skipped tier, so skipping never moves value to
later tiers. 0 = recompute from the balance when claimed.

fields.name: duration_secs
docs: Vesting only: seconds from the plan start to fully vested (the cliff
is `after_secs`, the total is `amount`). 0 for inheritance tiers.

fields.name: released
docs: Vesting only: gross amount released so far.

fields.name: after_secs
docs: Seconds of owner silence (since the last pulse) before this rule fires.

fields.name: mint
docs: `None` = SOL.

types.name: SkrFeePaid
docs: A release fee paid in SKR from the plan's fee reserve instead of in the
payout asset; `burned` of `fee` was burned, the rest went to the
treasury.

types.name: Vault
docs: Layout (final for mainnet). Clients read `owner` at byte 8, `plan_id` at
40, `guard` at 42 and the `guardian` option at 74 (after the 8-byte
discriminator); everything from `guardian` on sits at variable offsets.
New fields must be carved out of `_reserved` (keeping the total size), so
existing accounts decode with them zeroed and need no migration.

fields.name: plan_id
docs: Owner-chosen id; one owner can hold many independent plans.

fields.name: guard
docs: Device key: may only pulse and lock down, never move funds.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Trusted contact: may lock down (rate-limited) and co-sign early unlock.

fields.name: _reserved_interval
docs: Former check-in cadence slot, no longer used. Zero on new plans;
older accounts keep their stale bytes, which are never read.

fields.name: skip_grace_secs
docs: Owner-chosen time a due tier gets to pay before anyone may skip it.

fields.name: owner_last_seen
docs: Last wallet-signed (owner) action; bounds guard-only check-ins.

fields.name: guardian_ready_at
docs: Earliest time the guardian may lock down again.

fields.name: start_at
docs: Vesting: when every schedule starts vesting.

fields.name: revocable
docs: Vesting: the owner may stop future vesting (already vested stays).

fields.name: revoked_at
docs: Vesting: when it was revoked; 0 if never.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who funded the account rent (the owner, or a fee sponsor). Closing
the plan returns the rent to them, never to someone else.

fields.name: rent_paid
docs: Lamports the rent payer deposited at creation. Never withdrawable,
and exactly this much goes back to `rent_payer` on close, whatever
the rent sysvar says later.

fields.name: label
docs: Display name, e.g. "Kids" or "Emergency fund".

fields.name: stipend_paid
docs: Bit `i` set once rule `i`'s claim key got its gas stipend, so a
private-rail beneficiary is topped up at most once per rule.

fields.name: vest_period_secs
docs: Vesting: installment length. Vesting unlocks only at whole multiples
of it from `start_at` (fully at `duration_secs`); 0 = continuous.

fields.name: skr_fee_reserve
docs: SKR the owner set aside to pay release fees in SKR (see
`fund_skr_reserve`). Held in the vault's ATA of `skr_reserve_mint`
but never paid to tiers.

fields.name: skr_reserve_mint
docs: Mint the reserve is held in: the config's SKR mint when it was
funded, so a later SKR mint change cannot strand it.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Zeroed space for future fields; see the layout note above.

types.name: VestingInput
docs: One beneficiary's vesting schedule: `total` of `mint` (None = SOL) vests
linearly from `start_at` over `duration_secs` (in installments when the
plan has a vesting period); nothing is claimable before `cliff_secs`
have passed.
